raw_segments.text: As for the two books of the kings and the two books of the chronicles, besides the places
which mention such monuments as the writer Seth, remain till his own days, such as are
17.41, 1 chron, 4.41, 5.26. It is argument sufficient, they were written after the captivity
in Babylon, that the history of them is continued till that time. For the facts registered are
always more ancient than such books as make mention of, and quote the register. As these
books dough in divers places, referring the reader to the chronicles of the kings of Judah,
to the chronicles of the kings of Israel, to the books of the prophet Samuel, or the
prophet Nathan of the prophet Ahaja, to the vision of Jadot, to the books of the prophet
Servia, and of the prophet Atto.
